description.subject: A small handmade doll with a smooth white blank oval head and white hands, standing upright and facing the camera.
description.covering: A red knitted hooded jacket with a ribbed cowl collar and long sleeves to the wrists, a matching red knitted cap, cream knitted leggings with navy bands at the shins, and orange rubber boots.
description.setting: An outdoor spot paved with a deep bed of glossy, rounded river pebbles in charcoal and brown, with a pale mottled wall and a grey post behind.
description.light: Even, overcast light from above and in front, low in contrast and neutral to slightly warm in colour, leaving small bright reflections on the wet-looking pebbles.
description.materials: Red knitted yarn, smooth white painted or molded plastic, glossy polished pebbles, and orange rubber or vinyl.
description.anomaly: A round, translucent amber-orange bead sits on the front of the red knitted jacket at midriff height, like a glass button or a lens.
